property_summary: After any sequence of calls to setOwner, the owner variable always equals the last address that successfully passed the access check; the buggy version allows an arbitrary caller to become owner when executed via a contract called by the original owner, violating the invariant that only the current owner can change the owner through a direct EOA call.
change_summary: Replace the require condition with `require(msg.sender == tx.origin);` changing ownership check to tx.origin.
